newsitem.title: USA: Sano raises $15 mln in private placement.
newsitem.headline: Sano raises $15 mln in private placement.

text.p: Sano Corp said Thursday it raised $15 million in a private placement.
The company said it sold 1.2 million unregistered shares at $13.50 a share to two unnamed West Coast investment management firms, with each firm taking 600,000 shares.
The developer of controlled-release drug delivery systems said it plans to use the $15 million net proceeds to fund research and development programs.
Sano posted a $4.9 million loss, or $0.54 a share, in the first quarter, compared with a $2.9 million loss, or $0.32 a share, the year before. Its stock closed at 14-7/8 Wednesday.
